R² by prediction depth

Adding observed-upper VID improved raw-density R² at every depth from 100 to 500 m in all four evaluation groups. Both models use the same window-prioritized training rows: 1,446,106 unique profiles and 20,682,097 target rows across depths 100–1,000 m. The new model adds one raw-intensity feature to the existing 37 predictors, including normalized upper-profile slots, AGL and latitude/longitude.

Each point evaluates one target layer at the stated distance below the observed edge; k=5 means the target at 500 m, not a pool of the first five layers. Lines connect discrete depths. R² is calculated within each evaluation group and depth; it is not averaged across depths.

Raw-density error

The equally averaged per-depth RMSE at 100–500 m fell from 71.41 to 64.70 on historical reporting, 72.98 to 65.60 on the held-out year, 72.81 to 68.22 on held-out radars, and 73.50 to 68.92 on held-out radars in the held-out year. These are arithmetic means of five RMSE values, not pooled-row RMSE.

Experiment and interpretation

Whole-profile archive VID and observed-upper VID both remain ≥6.6 birds/km². The added predictor is raw observed-upper VID; it excludes hidden targets and is not log-transformed. Normalized slots retain their cube-root transformation. Fitting weights, sampled rows, hyperparameters and evaluation splits are the same. Training is from scratch for each model.

Both fits allow 20,000 rounds with patience 300 and select rounds by the mean unweighted raw-density RMSE across 100–500 m on stopping validation. The control selected 4,651 rounds (stopping RMSE 71.9346); the upper-VID model selected 5,585 rounds (65.6021). Both stopped before the ceiling. Model selection used stopping validation, not the displayed reporting/test scores.

Training uses 120 radar sites in 2013–2024. Historical reporting holds out nights at those sites; the temporal evaluation holds out 2025; the spatial evaluation uses 21 excluded radar sites in 2013–2024; the combined evaluation uses those sites in 2025. The evaluation rows are identical between models, and no evaluated target density is included in the added feature.

The larger improvements at deeper targets support including intensity alongside profile shape in this experiment. These are repeatedly examined development evaluations, not untouched final tests. Artificially hidden measured layers do not establish accuracy in genuinely unobserved layers below high radars. These plots show predictive performance, not feature importance or causal effects.

Reproduction

Local source: analysis/uppervid-performance/. Run Rscript render.R there to rebuild this self-contained report from comparison.csv and plots.R.

Control: conus-depth1to10-window-20261009-01. New model: conus-depth1to10-window-uppervid-20261009-02. Metrics source: artifacts/uppervid-comparison/comparison.csv under the new run in the vpts-extrapolation-863683271215 S3 archive. Failed attempt -01 did not fit a model and is not included.
